'''Category:Omniagent''' collects the demo pages whose subject is the Omniagent
platform itself: its HTTP API, its provider and model configuration, its secrets
store and redaction behaviour, how it tracks plugins and tools, and the
post-mortem of a task that went wrong.

These pages are derived from the omniagent wiki under
<code>Projects/Omniagent/</code> and <code>Reference/Omniagent/</code>. Each page
ends with the exact source path it came from.

== Members ==

* [[Models Yml]] - provider and model overrides via <code>config/models.yml</code>
* [[Secrets Store]] - the key/value store behind <code>$secret:NAME</code>
* [[Omniagent API]] - the core HTTP endpoint map
* [[Redaction]] - pluggable scrubbing of secrets from delivered content
* [[Plugin Tool Awareness]] - runtime plugin state and the tool naming rule
* [[Workstation Task Post Mortem]] - why one over-specified task never completed

== Related categories ==

* [[:Category:Workstation|Category:Workstation]] - the workstation service pages
* [[:Category:Templates|Category:Templates]] - the reusable page shapes

== See also ==

* [[Workstation Standard Config]] - the service that loads these definitions
* [[Template:OmniFact]] - the fact box used across these pages
